commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.

90+8' Paulo Gazzaniga doesn't have to worry about that one. Victor Parada puts a cross in towards Toni Martinez (Alaves), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball well wide of the left post.
90+7' Toni Martinez (Alaves) receives a cross in the box and attempts to shoot, but mishits the ball and misses the goal.
90+5' Great teamplay by Girona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
89' 2 - 2 Lucas Boye (Alaves) scores from a seemingly difficult position as he leaps high to head home a cross, putting the ball beyond the reach of the goalkeeper.
88' Eduardo Coudet has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Aitor Manas (Alaves) replacing Carles Alena.
88' Substitution. Antonio Blanco makes his way off the pitch and Ander Guevara (Alaves) comes on as his replacement.
88' The corner from Carles Alena (Alaves) is hurriedly cleared.
87' Carles Alena (Alaves) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
85' Carles Alena (Alaves) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
84' Bryan Gil goes off the pitch and Alejandro Frances (Girona) comes on.
84' The yellow card goes to Fran Beltran (Girona).
84' Michel has decided to make a change. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) replaces Viktor Tsygankov.
81' Denis Suarez (Alaves) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
81' The corner by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
80' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Girona have been awarded a corner kick.

80' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Antonio Sivera makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
79' Lucas Boye (Alaves) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
78' Lucas Boye (Alaves) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
76' Eduardo Coudet prepares a substitution. Pablo Ibanez is replaced by Denis Suarez (Alaves).
76' Claudio Echeverri (Girona) sees a yellow card from Adrian Cordero after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Calebe (Alaves) is replacing Angel Perez.
75' Carles Alena (Alaves) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
73' 1 - 2 Azzedine Ounahi passes to Viktor Tsygankov (Girona), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
70' Axel Witsel (Girona) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Antonio Sivera.
69' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
68' Substitution. Vladyslav Vanat did his best and is replaced by Azzedine Ounahi (Girona).
65' The attendance is 14117.
64' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
63' Carles Alena (Alaves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
62' Carles Alena (Alaves) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
61' The substitution is prepared. Claudio Echeverri (Girona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ivan Martin.
61' Michel has decided to substitute Thomas Lemar and he is replaced by Fran Beltran (Girona).
58' Big chance! A simple pass from Yusi left Carles Alena (Alaves) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post.
57' Carles Alena (Alaves) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
57' Carles Alena (Alaves) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Alaves have a corner.
55' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
54' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
54' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) is able to continue to play.
51' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
50' The shot by Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Paulo Gazzaniga.
49' Alaves fail to score from a corner as Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) leaps to collect the ball.
49' The foul by Yusi (Alaves) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Adrian Cordero.
48' Daley Blind (Girona) attempts to release Thomas Lemar with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Paulo Gazzaniga.
45+2' The resulting free kick from Carles Alena (Alaves) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Surely that's handball by one of the Girona players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
43' Toni Martinez (Alaves) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
42' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
38' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
37' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
36' Thomas Lemar (Girona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
35' Bryan Gil (Girona) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. Corner kick. Girona will have an opportunity.
34' Ivan Martin (Girona) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Antonio Sivera.
31' 1 - 1 Goal! Axel Witsel gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) glances a header into the net. 1:1.
30' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is about to take a corner kick.
30' Thomas Lemar (Girona) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked.
29' Girona have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
26' Toni Martinez (Alaves) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
24' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
24' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Sivera, who smothers the ball.
23' The resulting corner from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is cleared by the defence.
23' A lofted cross from Bryan Gil (Girona) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' Arnau Martinez (Girona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
20' A quickly taken corner by Girona.
20' Neat passing move from Girona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
16' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Daley Blind (Girona).
14' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
13' Girona are awarded a mid-range free kick.
12' Adrian Cordero shows a yellow card to Toni Martinez (Alaves) for a tough tackle.
11' Angel Perez (Alaves) plays a lovely through ball to Toni Martinez, but he can't beat Paulo Gazzaniga and loses the ball.
9' Angel Perez (Alaves) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot well wide of the left post.
7' Toni Martinez (Alaves) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Yusi passes the ball to the feet of Lucas Boye (Alaves), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 1:0.
4' Daley Blind (Girona) plays a long ball to Viktor Tsygankov, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
